The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, so there is nothing for POL-GEN-05 to execute and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

The judge's explanation, as written

Rider and driver: on this trip's own facts the no-show is established. DRV-09751 accepted at 22:22:34, tapped 'I'm Here' at 22:31:15, and the GPS trace independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that same second, holding position for one continuous 408-second run (42 qualifying fixes) until 22:38:03 — well past the 180-second free waiting period in force. The driver cancelled at 22:38:07 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding event is recorded, and the rider's own device track never came closer than 851 m to the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are therefore satisfied and the SGD 4.50 fee would normally stand, with SGD 3.60 (80% of the fee) paid to the driver under POL-NS-07. That payout is displaced by the driver's own profile, on a check the driver's advocate properly conceded. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming test requires both limbs and both are met: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the '4 or more' limb) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Where both limbs hold, compensation is WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal: no money moves now, both money fields are null, and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded while a human reviewer decides. The reviewer's packet carries both briefs, the pre-pass report, the clauses relied on and this reasoning, and directs a full refund of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee. I tested and set aside the routes either side raised. POL-NS-06: the measured dwell of 408 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum, the derived shortfall is −228 seconds (a surplus), so no waiting-period refund arises; the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02751-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is irrelevant to a dwell that needs no accumulation. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is true — the fix at the marker shares the timestamp 22:31:15 and the driver is stationary, not the 300 m or 15 km/h that would make it false. POL-NS-04: the only message in the waiting window is the driver's own, so the rider sent nothing locating or coordinating and limb (a) fails — no rider exoneration. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so the arrival rests on the exported trace, which fully supports it. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08 (zero-second gap, no clock skew, chat count reconciles to the trip record, fare line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd), and every deciding fact rests on weight-1.0 records, so confidence is not capped below the floor; escalation is triggered by POL-NS-09(d), not by low confidence. I did not use rating, account age, lifetime trips, cancellation rate or the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags / prior_disputes_filed on either party: POL-GEN-01 makes them context only, and the only profile counters that decide anything here are the two POL-NS-07 names. The sum at issue (the SGD 4.50 held) is below the SGD 8.00 POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, but escalation is terminal and that amount stays frozen. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check, and it trips on both limbs that clause requires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which is 4 or more, and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. Because both limbs hold, the driver's compensation must be WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09. No other profile field may be used for this check, and no such field is offered here.

evidence EV-DPROF-02751 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09

kept That escalation is mandatory and, under POL-NS-09, terminal: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming trip engages trigger (d), no monetary ruling issues from the automated pipeline, and the disputed $4.50 is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded while the human review is pending. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalated amount is held rather than collected, so the rider is not left carrying the disputed charge while the review runs, and describing escalation as a refund to the rider would be wrong: it is a hold plus a directed refund.

evidence EV-DPROF-02751, EV-FARE-02751 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-03

kept POL-NS-07 also fixes what the escalation packet must contain where the anti-farming check trips: the packet must DIRECT THE REVIEWER to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. The only sum in play is the $4.50 cancellation-fee line, which is the whole of total_charged on this trip, with refund_issued_sgd still 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED, so a direction to refund the rider in full reaches the entire contested amount and not a fragment of it.

evidence EV-FARE-02751, EV-DPROF-02751, EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09

kept The rider does not dispute the arrival and dwell arithmetic and does not pretend POL-NS-06 assists her: the driver's trace shows a single qualifying in-geofence run of 408 seconds against the 180 second minimum in force for this STANDARD-zone pickup (it would clear the legacy 300 second constant as well), carried by 42 qualifying fixes with a zero-second maximum gap. POL-NS-06 therefore does not make this fee refundable, and the rider's case is not a waiting-period shortfall: it is about whether this driver may receive the fee at all.

evidence EV-GPS-02751, EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The arrival on this trip is not platform-confirmed, so POL-NS-12 has no application: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON and not GPS_AUTO, which means the driver's 'I'm Here' tap and the wait-timer events are not a platform telemetry record of a full-resolution geofence measurement. The arrival marker is the driver's own assertion, and it stands or falls on the exported trace under POL-NS-02 and the POL-NS-05 false-marker test rather than on any independent platform measurement.

evidence EV-TRIP-02751, EV-GPS-02751 · clauses POL-NS-12, POL-NS-05

kept No traffic advisory covers this pickup, and the absence is itself citable: EV-ADVIS-02751-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and this claim is expressly advanced on an impaired (absent) artifact. Because the advisory is missing rather than present and populated, POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable, and no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT on the pickup road can be relied on by the driver to explain, extend or excuse any part of his waiting.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02751-01 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept The rider's profile cannot be turned against her. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (1) is a lifetime counter and is not the no_show_disputes_30d that POL-NS-09(d) reads, and prior_disputes_filed (2) is not the disputes_with_counterparty_90d that POL-NS-09(c) reads; POL-GEN-01 makes both of them context only. On the fields the clauses actually name, the rider shows no_show_disputes_30d = 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, so no escalation trigger and no adverse finding can be constructed against her on profile.

evidence EV-RPROF-02751 · clauses POL-GEN-01, POL-NS-09

evidence EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-01

evidence EV-GPS-02751, EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

That is more than double the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied with 228 seconds to spare.

evidence EV-GPS-02751, EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-01

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied, and with all four limbs the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

evidence EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05. The first qualifying in-geofence fix shares the arrival timestamp 22:31:15 exactly, and the driver's approach speed falls to 0.0 kph as he holds the pickup, so there is no fix at the arrival moment placing him more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above. My client's clock and his position agree at the marker.

evidence EV-GPS-02751, EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-05

kept There is no waiting-period shortfall. The measured in-geofence dwell of 408 seconds exceeds the required minimum, and the derived figure reports a shortfall of −228 seconds, i.e. a surplus. POL-NS-06 therefore licenses no refund of this fee.

evidence EV-GPS-02751 · clauses POL-NS-06

kept EV-ADVIS-02751-01 is MISSING — no traffic advisory covers this pickup — so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation of separate intervals is unavailable: the artifact carries weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that as POL-GEN-02 requires. It costs my client nothing, because he does not need accumulation: his dwell is a single uninterrupted in-geofence run.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02751-01, EV-GPS-02751 · clauses POL-NS-06

kept The rider's own device track never approaches the pickup. Over 70 fixes from 22:28:47 to 22:39:10 it stays between 851 m and 858 m from the pickup pin, and only 0 of those fixes fall inside the STANDARD rider-presence radius of 100 m. On the rider's own telemetry, the rider was nowhere near the registered pickup point during the waiting window.

evidence EV-GPS-02751 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider and should not be read as if it could. The only message in the chat log is the driver's own 'im at the pickup point', sent 22:31:35 and read at 22:32:05; the rider sent nothing during the waiting window. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 fails, so there is no unanswered rider message for limb (b) to bite on. The driver, not the rider, was the party trying to coordinate.

evidence EV-CHAT-02751 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept Where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force — SGD 3.60 of the SGD 4.50 charged, the net figure the fare breakdown itself reports as driver_compensation. That is the entitlement this verified no-show earns.

evidence EV-FARE-02751, EV-TRIP-02751 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03

kept I will be straight about the one limb of POL-NS-07 that cuts against my own client, rather than overstate it. The anti-farming check trips on this record: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which meets the '4 or more' limb, and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (40) is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs engage, so compensation for this trip is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 rather than paying out — notwithstanding that the no-show itself is fully established on this trip's own evidence, as claims 1 to 4 show. Only these two named counters are used; the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not this test.

evidence EV-DPROF-02751 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09

kept Nothing in this bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08. The GPS trace has 100 percent coverage at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec of 0.0, the 'arrived' event and the first in-geofence fix share the timestamp 22:31:15 (no clock skew), and the fare breakdown's SGD 4.50 cancellation line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. It costs my client nothing, because he does not need accumulation: his dwell is a single uninterrupted in-geofence run. KEPT; The rider's own device track never approaches the pickup. Over 70 fixes from 22:28:47 to 22:39:10 it stays between 851 m and 858 m from the pickup pin, and only 0 of those fixes fall inside the STANDARD rider-presence radius of 100 m. On the rider's own telemetry, the rider was nowhere near the registered pickup point during the waiting window. KEPT; POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider and should not be read as if it could. The only message in the chat log is the driver's own 'im at the pickup point', sent 22:31:35 and read at 22:32:05; the rider sent nothing during the waiting window. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 fails, so there is no unanswered rider message for limb (b) to bite on. The driver, not the rider, was the party trying to coordinate. KEPT; Where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force — SGD 3.60 of the SGD 4.50 charged, the net figure the fare breakdown itself reports as driver_compensation. That is the entitlement this verified no-show earns. KEPT; I will be straight about the one limb of POL-NS-07 that cuts against my own client, rather than overstate it. The anti-farming check trips on this record: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which meets the '4 or more' limb, and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (40) is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs engage, so compensation for this trip is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 rather than paying out — notwithstanding that the no-show itself is fully established on this trip's own evidence, as claims 1 to 4 show. Only these two named counters are used; the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not this test. KEPT; Nothing in this bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08. The GPS trace has 100 percent coverage at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec of 0.0, the 'arrived' event and the first in-geofence fix share the timestamp 22:31:15 (no clock skew), and the fare breakdown's SGD 4.50 cancellation line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged, so no impairment caps confidence on the driver's arrival and dwell below the 0.70 floor. KEPT
